craft_notes: Sthāyin: courage of shelter. Device: end-dash→colon (staging stated, bliss released); comma→dash (unveiling held, hail lands). Rejected: naming the churn (what delusion?) — killed: bhrānti kept unfilled; Vṛtti's paurāṇika gloss lives in argmap. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: To thee who stage the churned dim and crack it: bliss
of gnosis, twinless — God, who hoods and unhoods: hail.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namas te bhavasambhrāntabhrāntim udbhāvya bhindate jñānānandaṃ ca nirdvandvaṃ deva vṛtvā vivṛṇvate

reads_against.argmap: Bow to you who, having manifested the becoming-agitated delusion, breaks.; To knowledge-bliss, nondual — O god, having covered, to uncoverer. → Bow to breaker and uncoverer of delusion, knowledge-bliss nondual.
c1_essence: Breaker and uncoverer of churned stupor: gnosis-bliss without pairs.
reads_against.l2: To you I bow — you conjure the churned stupor of becoming, then shatter it: bliss of gnosis, no pairs — O god, veiler and unveiler.
l3: To thee who stage the churned dim and crack it — bliss
